description: This file contains internal implementation details for resizing std::string objects in the Abseil C++ library, including traits for uninitialized resize and append operations, with support for different string implementations.

classes.name: ResizeUninitializedTraits
classes.description: Type trait to determine if a string type has a __resize_default_init method and to provide a resize method accordingly.

classes.name: AppendUninitializedTraits
classes.description: Type trait to determine if a string type has a __append_default_init method and to provide an append method accordingly.

methods.name: ResizeUninitializedTraits::Resize
methods.description: Resizes the string, using __resize_default_init if available, otherwise resize.

methods.name: STLStringSupportsNontrashingResize
methods.description: Checks if the string type supports uninitialized resize.

methods.name: STLStringReserveAmortized
methods.description: Reserves capacity for string growth with exponential backoff.

methods.name: AppendUninitializedTraits::Append
methods.description: Appends default-initialized characters, using __append_default_init if available.

methods.name: STLStringResizeUninitializedAmortized
methods.description: Resizes string with uninitialized characters, using exponential growth.
